title: Junior Automation Engineer
description: We are looking for a Junior Automation Engineer who can contribute using SIT, UAT, Acceptance testing, Domain Testing and domain experience from the candidate's background.
responsibilities: Validate requirements and ensure quality across releases
Create and execute test plans, cases, and reports
Work with cross-functional teams to resolve defects and improve reliability
qualifications: Strong experience in testing and quality engineering
Familiarity with regression, API, and release validation
